label: Kantian MEANS_1 principle: no harm as a MEANS_1, and a proportionate rescue
definition: MeansPrinciple c: intervening is permissible exactly when the one's harm is not a causal means (MEANS_1) to the saving and intervening costs strictly fewer lives. Plans and object classification play no role.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
